description: Report on Government Services, Productivity Commission is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Productivity Commission. The Report on Government Services (RoGS) provides information on the equity, effectiveness and efficiency of government services in Australia. This includes information on early childhood education and care, school and vocational education, police services and housing. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
